description: This NRC collection supplies selected weather years for 564 locations across Canada. It includes typical meteorological years for energy calculations, typical and extreme temperature years, moisture reference years for hygrothermal analysis, and overheating years representing different heat-wave characteristics. The underlying simulations cover a 1991–2021 historical baseline and seven future warming levels between 0.5 and 3.5 degrees Celsius. The National Research Council Canada publishes the files through its digital repository under the Open Government Licence, Canada, allowing free reuse. The inspected registry does not specify the individual file format. Selected reference years compress long climate sequences and should not be interpreted as continuous forecasts. They can help compare heating, cooling and overheating scenarios in building models such as model-energyplus, subject to checking the required weather-file fields.
